title: Classic American Apple Pie
description: A traditional dessert with a crumbly crust and sweet American apples. This classic recipe serves a crowd and makes a great dessert or snack.
instructions: Peel, core, and chop the apples into a large bowl.
Add sugar, flour, and spices to the bowl and mix.
Roll out the ground bake mix and place it in a 9-inch pie dish.
Fill the pie crust with the apple mixture and dot the top with butter.
Roll out the remaining pie dough and use it to cover the pie.
Crimp the edges to seal and cut a few slits in the top.
Brush the egg wash over the pie and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake for 40-50 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Let the pie cool for at least 30 minutes before serving.
